reasons: Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on every material term: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, maintained through the term plus one year.
Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, plus favorable primary-coverage, cancellation-notice, and non-limitation language.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present; the rationale accurately describes the clause.
